comparison.objective: Raise and rotate a monitor, preserve tilt, relock its spring axes, and remain hands-off.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-axis articulated adjustment and relocking while avoiding obstacles.
comparison.success_condition: Raise 130 mm, pivot 90 degrees, preserve tilt, relock, and remain hands-off for 20 seconds without veto events.
comparison.reason: Although both set and retain articulation, this task manipulates independent spring index locks rather than a coupled screw/jam-nut setting requiring concentric countertorque and repeated-cycle verification.
